From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Regional tier alignment & preflight — BrightScale POC

Hi Samir / Elena,

Thanks again for agreeing to run the BrightScale POC with us. To make the hands-on session productive, proposing a short preflight + a focused working session where we cover: 
- Prompt review and eval set (30–45m)
- Routing policy mapping (model selection, tiering, fallback rules) (60–90m)
- Regional breakout & capacity requirements (30m)
- Load-test plan and success criteria (30m)

Suggested blocks (PST):
- Tue Dec 14, 09:00–12:00 (3hr)
- Wed Dec 15, 12:00–15:00 (3hr)
- Fri Dec 18, 10:00–13:00 (3hr) — preferred if you need end-of-week wrap

Prework: please upload a short prompt set and any latency/SLO targets to the shared Drive folder. I've attached a preflight checklist and a timezone matrix so we can lock the right window.

Ask: can you confirm which of these dates works for your ops + ML team and whether you need a regional breakout (EU/APAC) as a separate session?

Attachments: routing-preflight-checklist.pdf, timezone-matrix.xlsx

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt

Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 11:26:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Regional tier alignment & preflight — BrightScale POC

Hi Hannah — thanks for the plan and the checklist.

Quick notes from our side: several of our engineers will be out the week of the 14th for year-end deployments. The 15th is tight for ops. The 18th looks best for us, ideally 10:00 PT so folks on East Coast and LatAm can join midday. We'd prefer a 3-hour block to get through both policy mapping and a short sandbox run.

We'll upload a small prompt set (10–12 examples) and latency targets by next Tuesday.

Also: can you share a sandbox endpoint or credentials for a small traffic run? We prefer not to run load tests on production model endpoints.

—Samir

Subject: Fwd: Regional tier alignment & preflight — BrightScale POC

Hannah — forwarding Samir's note. A couple of internal asks before we lock: 
- Recommend splitting the 3-hr into 90m architecture/policy + 90m hands-on so we can iterate on routing rules and then exercise them in the sandbox.
- We'll need to reserve Dedicated capacity for the load test burst (ask to infra: 1x A10G pool for 30 minutes). Ben can own that.
- Marissa, can you surface any compliance constraints for EU data residency if BrightScale asks for an EU breakout?

I'll add Markus (runtime team) on the invite as runbook owner. Hannah, can you also include the HubSpot deal link in the invite so Sales has the record?

V
Vivek
VP, Product Ops (cc: runbook/ops)

Hannah — Dec 18 at 10:00 PT works for us. We'll plan for a 3-hour session and bring our ML lead + infra engineer.

Requests: 
- Please share a sandbox URL and a short credentials file at least 24h prior.
- We'll need a breakout on EU latency and a short discussion about failover sequencing (primary -> regional fallback -> low-cost fallback).
